description: This file defines a class for a memory node component called BufferWindowMemory, including its initialization, chat message retrieval, and management methods, integrating with a database and external memory utilities.

classes.name: BufferWindowMemory_Memory
classes.description: A class implementing a memory node that uses a window of size k to surface recent chat history, with initialization and message retrieval methods.

classes.name: BufferWindowMemoryExtended
classes.description: An extension of FlowiseWindowMemory that manages chat messages with database integration, supporting retrieval and session management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the BufferWindowMemoryExtended instance with parameters from nodeData and options, setting up database and session info.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from the database, optionally returning base message objects or formatted IMessage objects, with support for session override and message prepending.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, managed at server level.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, managed at server level.
